name: University Valley
coordinate_note: Geometry is Marinova et al. 2011: 77 deg 51.8 min S, 160 deg 43 min E, Quartermain Mountains, about 1730 m. The same abstract also says about 1700 m. Williams et al. 2018 print 77.868 S, 163.758 E and 1700 m. That longitude is not the Quartermain site next to Beacon Valley.
evidence_note: Dry permafrost over an ice table that deepens from the valley head to the mouth. Phoenix comparison uses this valley against lower Taylor Valley.

name: Central Beacon Valley polygon site
coordinate_note: Geometry is the Liu et al. 2018 thermistor polygon: 77 deg 49 min S, 160 deg 39 min E. Liu et al. 2015 give Beacon Valley as 77 deg 49 min S, 161 deg 39 min E. Elevation 1350 m is the middle-valley floor stated in Liu et al. 2015, not a survey of the thermistor.
evidence_note: Massive ground ice 30-50 cm down, under sublimation till, on one polygon. Not a centroid for the whole valley.

name: Drill Hill
coordinate_note: Glass and Seitz 2021: 75 deg 25.25 min N, 89 deg 45.60 min W.
evidence_note: Fallback breccia with intermittent ice, used for planetary drill tests. Active layer about 50-70 cm in summer.
